section_path: What's new in Django 4.2 > Minor features > Models
raw_text:
* :class:`F() <django.db.models.F>` expressions that output ``BooleanField``
  can now be negated using ``~F()`` (inversion operator).
text: F() expressions that output BooleanField can now be negated using ~F() (inversion operator).

raw_text:
* The undocumented ``Query.annotation_select_mask`` attribute is changed from a
  set of strings to an ordered list of strings.
text: The undocumented Query.annotation_select_mask attribute is changed from a set of strings to an ordered list of strings.

raw_text:
* In order to improve accessibility, the admin's changelist filter is now
  rendered in a ``<nav>`` tag instead of a ``<div>``.
text: In order to improve accessibility, the admin's changelist filter is now rendered in a <nav> tag instead of a <div>.

raw_text:
* ``HttpRequest.accepted_types`` is now sorted by the client's preference,
  based on the request's ``Accept`` header.
text: HttpRequest.accepted_types is now sorted by the client's preference, based on the request's Accept header.

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused improper values to be returned
  from ``QuerySet.values_list()`` when duplicate field names were specified
  (:ticket:`36288`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused improper values to be returned from QuerySet.values_list() when duplicate field names were specified (36288).

raw_text:
* Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where subqueries using ``"pk"`` to reference models
  with a ``CompositePrimaryKey`` failed to raise ``ValueError`` when too many
  or too few columns were selected (:ticket:`36392`).
text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where subqueries using "pk" to reference models with a CompositePrimaryKey failed to raise ValueError when too many or too few columns were selected (36392).

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused :meth:`.QuerySet.bulk_update` to
  incorrectly convert ``None`` to JSON ``null`` instead of SQL ``NULL`` for
  ``JSONField`` (:ticket:`36419`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused QuerySet.bulk_update to incorrectly convert None to JSON null instead of SQL NULL for JSONField (36419).

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.3 where ``Value(None, JSONField())`` used in
  a :class:`~django.db.models.expressions.When` condition was incorrectly
  serialized as SQL ``NULL`` instead of JSON ``null`` (:ticket:`36453`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.3 where Value(None, JSONField()) used in a django.db.models.expressions.When condition was incorrectly serialized as SQL NULL instead of JSON null (36453).

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.1 that prevented the usage of ``UNNEST``
  PostgreSQL strategy of ``QuerySet.bulk_create()`` with foreign keys
  (:ticket:`36502`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.1 that prevented the usage of UNNEST PostgreSQL strategy of QuerySet.bulk_create() with foreign keys (36502).

raw_text:
* Fixed a bug where using ``QuerySet.values()`` or ``values_list()`` with a
  ``ForeignObject`` composed of multiple fields returned incorrect results
  instead of tuples of the referenced fields (:ticket:`36431`).
text: Fixed a bug where using QuerySet.values() or values_list() with a ForeignObject composed of multiple fields returned incorrect results instead of tuples of the referenced fields (36431).

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that reduced the color contrast of
  the chosen label of ``filter_horizontal`` and ``filter_vertical`` widgets
  within a ``TabularInline`` (:ticket:`36601`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that reduced the color contrast of the chosen label of filter_horizontal and filter_vertical widgets within a TabularInline (36601).

raw_text:
* Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where proxy models having a ``CompositePrimaryKey``
  incorrectly raised a ``models.E042`` system check error.
text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where proxy models having a CompositePrimaryKey incorrectly raised a models.E042 system check error.

section_path: Backwards incompatible changes in 6.0 > Database backend API
raw_text:
* :class:`~django.db.backends.base.schema.BaseDatabaseSchemaEditor` and
  PostgreSQL backends no longer use ``CASCADE`` when dropping a column.
text: django.db.backends.base.schema.BaseDatabaseSchemaEditor and PostgreSQL backends no longer use CASCADE when dropping a column.

raw_text:
* Reverted an undocumented optimization in Django 6.0 that modified permission
  :attr:`~django.contrib.auth.models.Permission.name` and
  :attr:`~django.contrib.auth.models.Permission.codename` values when renaming
  models via a migration. This change could affect unrelated
  :class:`~django.contrib.auth.models.Permission` objects (:ticket:`36843`) and
  did not report conflicts (:ticket:`36793`).
text: Reverted an undocumented optimization in Django 6.0 that modified permission django.contrib.auth.models.Permission.name and django.contrib.auth.models.Permission.codename values when renaming models via a migration. This change could affect unrelated django.contrib.auth.models.Permission objects (36843) and did not report conflicts (36793).

section_path: What's new in Django 4.2 > Minor features > Models
raw_text:
* ``QuerySet`` now extensively supports filtering against
  :ref:`window-functions` with the exception of disjunctive filter lookups
  against window functions when performing aggregation.
text: QuerySet now extensively supports filtering against window-functions with the exception of disjunctive filter lookups against window functions when performing aggregation.

section_path: What's new in Django 5.0 > Minor features > File Storage
raw_text:
* :meth:`.File.open` now passes all positional (``*args``) and keyword
  arguments (``**kwargs``) to Python's built-in :func:`python:open`.
text: File.open now passes all positional (args) and keyword arguments (*kwargs) to Python's built-in python:open.

raw_text:
* The ``django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2.open()`` method is deprecated. Use the
  :class:`~django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2` constructor instead.
text: The django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2.open() method is deprecated. Use the django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2 constructor instead.

section_path: What's new in Django 5.2 > Minor features > Email
raw_text:
* The new :meth:`~django.core.mail.EmailMultiAlternatives.body_contains` method
  returns a boolean indicating whether a provided text is contained in the
  email ``body`` and in all attached MIME type ``text/*`` alternatives.
text: The new django.core.mail.EmailMultiAlternatives.body_contains method returns a boolean indicating whether a provided text is contained in the email body and in all attached MIME type text/* alternatives.

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using
  ``QuerySet.select_for_update(of=(…))`` with ``values()/values_list()``
  including expressions (:ticket:`36301`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using QuerySet.select_for_update(of=(…)) with values()/values_list() including expressions (36301).

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using ``OuterRef``
  in the ``filter`` argument of an ``Aggregate`` expression (:ticket:`36404`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using OuterRef in the filter argument of an Aggregate expression (36404).

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.2 where the ``q`` parameter was removed from
  the internal ``django.http.MediaType.params`` property (:ticket:`36446`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.2 where the q parameter was removed from the internal django.http.MediaType.params property (36446).

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.2 where :meth:`HttpRequest.get_preferred_type()
  <django.http.HttpRequest.get_preferred_type>` incorrectly preferred more
  specific media types with a lower quality (:ticket:`36447`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.2 where HttpRequest.get_preferred_type() incorrectly preferred more specific media types with a lower quality (36447).

raw_text:
* Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when using a ``ManyToManyField`` on a model with
  a composite primary key, by extending the ``fields.E347`` system check
  (:ticket:`36530`).
text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when using a ManyToManyField on a model with a composite primary key, by extending the fields.E347 system check (36530).

raw_text:
* Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where ``QuerySet.first()`` and ``QuerySet.last()``
  raised an error on querysets performing aggregation that selected all fields
  of a composite primary key.
text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where QuerySet.first() and QuerySet.last() raised an error on querysets performing aggregation that selected all fields of a composite primary key.

section_path: What's new in Django 6.0 > Minor features > :mod:`django.contrib.gis`
raw_text:
* The new :attr:`.BaseGeometryWidget.base_layer` attribute allows specifying a
  JavaScript map base layer, enabling customization of map tile providers.
text: The new BaseGeometryWidget.base_layer attribute allows specifying a JavaScript map base layer, enabling customization of map tile providers.

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 that prevented changing the name of a
  :class:`~django.db.models.ManyToManyField` from taking effect when applying
  migrations (:ticket:`36800`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 that prevented changing the name of a django.db.models.ManyToManyField from taking effect when applying migrations (36800).

raw_text:
* The ``BaseUserManager.make_random_password()`` method is deprecated. See
  `recipes and best practices
  <https://docs.python.org/3/library/secrets.html#recipes-and-best-practices>`_
  for using Python's :py:mod:`secrets` module to generate passwords.
text: The BaseUserManager.make_random_password() method is deprecated. See recipes and best practices for using Python's secrets module to generate passwords.

section_path: What's new in Django 5.0 > Minor features > :mod:`django.contrib.gis`
raw_text:
* The new
  :class:`ClosestPoint() <django.contrib.gis.db.models.functions.ClosestPoint>`
  function returns a 2-dimensional point on the geometry that is closest to
  another geometry.
text: The new ClosestPoint() function returns a 2-dimensional point on the geometry that is closest to another geometry.

raw_text:
* The ``map_width`` and ``map_height`` attributes of ``BaseGeometryWidget`` are
  removed.
text: The map_width and map_height attributes of BaseGeometryWidget are removed.

section_path: What's new in Django 5.2 > Minor features > Serialization
raw_text:
* Each serialization format now defines a ``Deserializer`` class, rather than a
  function, to improve extensibility when defining a
  :ref:`custom serialization format <custom-serialization-formats>`.
text: Each serialization format now defines a Deserializer class, rather than a function, to improve extensibility when defining a custom serialization format.

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using ``update()``
  on a ``QuerySet`` filtered against a related model and including references
  to annotations through ``values()`` (:ticket:`36360`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using update() on a QuerySet filtered against a related model and including references to annotations through values() (36360).

raw_text:
* Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where :meth:`HttpRequest.get_preferred_type()
  <django.http.HttpRequest.get_preferred_type>` did not account for media type
  parameters in ``Accept`` headers, reducing specificity in content negotiation
  (:ticket:`36411`).
text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where HttpRequest.get_preferred_type() did not account for media type parameters in Accept headers, reducing specificity in content negotiation (36411).

raw_text:
* Fixed a log injection possibility by migrating remaining response logging
  to ``django.utils.log.log_response()``, which safely escapes arguments such
  as the request path to prevent unsafe log output (:cve:`2025-48432`).
text: Fixed a log injection possibility by migrating remaining response logging to django.utils.log.log_response(), which safely escapes arguments such as the request path to prevent unsafe log output (2025-48432).

raw_text:
* Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when performing an ``__in`` lookup involving a
  composite primary key and a subquery on backends that lack native support for
  tuple lookups (:ticket:`36464`).
text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when performing an __in lookup involving a composite primary key and a subquery on backends that lack native support for tuple lookups (36464).

raw_text:
* Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when filtering against a composite primary key
  using a tuple containing expressions (:ticket:`36522`).
text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when filtering against a composite primary key using a tuple containing expressions (36522).

section_path: What's new in Django 6.0 > Minor features > Models
raw_text:
* :doc:`Constraints </ref/models/constraints>` now implement a ``check()``
  method that is already registered with the check framework.
text: Constraints now implement a check() method that is already registered with the check framework.

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 that caused
  :meth:`~django.db.models.query.QuerySet.bulk_create` to crash
  when introspecting the connection on SQLite (:ticket:`36818`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 that caused django.db.models.query.QuerySet.bulk_create to crash when introspecting the connection on SQLite (36818).

section_path: What's new in Django 4.2 > Minor features > :mod:`django.contrib.auth`
raw_text:
* The new :class:`~django.contrib.auth.forms.BaseUserCreationForm` is now the
  recommended base class for customizing the user creation form.
text: The new django.contrib.auth.forms.BaseUserCreationForm is now the recommended base class for customizing the user creation form.

section_path: What's new in Django 5.0 > Minor features > Models
raw_text:
* On MariaDB 10.7+, ``UUIDField`` is now created as ``UUID`` column rather than
  ``CHAR(32)`` column. See the migration guide above for more details on
  :ref:`migrating-uuidfield`.
text: On MariaDB 10.7+, UUIDField is now created as UUID column rather than CHAR(32) column. See the migration guide above for more details on migrating-uuidfield.

raw_text:
* In order to improve accessibility, the admin's footer is now rendered in
  a ``<footer>`` tag instead of a ``<div>``, and also moved below the
  ``<div id="main">`` element.
text: In order to improve accessibility, the admin's footer is now rendered in a <footer> tag instead of a <div>, and also moved below the <div id="main"> element.

raw_text:
* The ``all`` argument for the ``django.contrib.staticfiles.finders.find()``
  function is deprecated in favor of the ``find_all`` argument.
text: The all argument for the django.contrib.staticfiles.finders.find() function is deprecated in favor of the find_all argument.

raw_text:
* Fixed a data corruption possibility in ``file_move_safe()`` when
  ``allow_overwrite=True``, where leftover content from a previously larger
  file could remain after overwriting with a smaller one due to lack of
  truncation (:ticket:`36298`).
text: Fixed a data corruption possibility in file_move_safe() when allow_overwrite=True, where leftover content from a previously larger file could remain after overwriting with a smaller one due to lack of truncation (36298).

raw_text:
* Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where calling ``QuerySet.in_bulk()`` with an
  ``id_list`` argument on models with a ``CompositePrimaryKey`` failed to
  observe database parameter limits (:ticket:`36416`).
text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where calling QuerySet.in_bulk() with an id_list argument on models with a CompositePrimaryKey failed to observe database parameter limits (36416).

raw_text:
* Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when validating a model that uses
  ``GeneratedField`` or constraints composed of ``Q`` and ``Case`` lookups
  (:ticket:`36518`).
text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when validating a model that uses GeneratedField or constraints composed of Q and Case lookups (36518).

section_path: What's new in Django 6.0 > Minor features > Templates
raw_text:
* The :ttag:`querystring` template tag now consistently prefixes the returned
  query string with a ``?``, ensuring reliable link generation behavior.
text: The querystring template tag now consistently prefixes the returned query string with a ?, ensuring reliable link generation behavior.

raw_text:
* Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 where the :attr:`.Widget.use_fieldset`
  attribute of :class:`~django.forms.ClearableFileInput` was flipped
  from ``False`` to ``True`` (:ticket:`36829`).
text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 where the Widget.use_fieldset attribute of django.forms.ClearableFileInput was flipped from False to True (36829).

raw_text:
* The :option:`makemigrations --check` option no longer creates missing
  migration files.
text: The makemigrations --check option no longer creates missing migration files.

raw_text: * The minimum supported version of SQLite is increased from 3.21.0 to 3.27.0.
text: The minimum supported version of SQLite is increased from 3.21.0 to 3.27.0.

raw_text:
* The undocumented ``django.urls.converters.get_converter()`` function is
  removed.
text: The undocumented django.urls.converters.get_converter() function is removed.

section_path: What's new in Django 5.2 > Minor features > :mod:`django.contrib.syndication`
raw_text:
* All :class:`~django.utils.feedgenerator.SyndicationFeed` classes now support
  a ``stylesheets`` attribute. If specified, an ``<? xml-stylesheet ?>``
  processing instruction will be added to the top of the document for each
  stylesheet in the given list. See :ref:`feed-stylesheets` for more details.
text: All django.utils.feedgenerator.SyndicationFeed classes now support a stylesheets attribute. If specified, an <? xml-stylesheet ?> processing instruction will be added to the top of the document for each stylesheet in the given list. See feed-stylesheets for more details.
